unsuitable_reason: Not an acute pesticide-poisoning case: this is a case study of chronic occupational organophosphorus compound exposure causing male infertility (oligoasthenoteratozoospermia), managed with Ayurvedic therapy (panchakarma, Shilajit) and IVF/PICSI. There is no acute poisoning episode, no toxidrome, no emergency care, and no acute clinical treatment (e.g., no atropine/oxime, no cholinergic toxidrome). The exposure is inferred from the husband's occupation rather than an acute ingestion/acute clinical event.
